accepted: For the four named one-shot cells under the configured 100 us fixed latency + 25 us request overhead, 50 MiB/s, 4 KiB maximum-range simulator, both ABBA directions improve total p50/p95/p99/mean by about 62-64 percent and the open_stream operation interval by about 98.4-99.9 percent.

One-shot positional source work is exact and proportional on the named corpora: the control returns the complete root Mini Stream while the candidate returns one exact 36-byte or 4095-byte target range.
tradeoff: Repeated candidate calls intentionally add one target-sized request before root-cache materialization. Several many-small configured-simulator repeat cells regress p50/mean by about 0.3-1.2 percent and tails by up to about 2.8 percent consistently; one repeat-8 p99 leg regresses 9.5 percent but reverses direction in the paired leg and has same-implementation tail drift.
No generic repeated-read improvement is accepted. Wide-root repeated cells are near neutral under the configured model.
withheld: No generic local wall-clock claim because several many-small and 36-byte wide-root tail/control distributions are unstable even though the operation interval and exact source-work direction agree.
No allocation, RSS, peak-memory, physical-I/O, cold-cache, remote/network/device, decompression, native DOC/XLS/PPT, OOXML, ODF, RTF, or iWork claim.

status: accepted scoped one-shot simulator result; repeated-work tradeoff retained
